title: Linkivo — Smart Link Management PWA
short_description: A progressive web app for intelligent link management with a weighted discovery system and cinematic GSAP animations.
content:
About This Project

Linkivo is my most advanced active project — a sophisticated Progressive Web Application for intelligent link management. It features a Firebase-backed architecture, a custom client-side router built in Vanilla JavaScript, and cinematic animations powered by GSAP.

The latest version (v1.4.5) introduces a cinematic splash screen where link cards converge into an auto-locking padlock, complete with particle burst effects and dynamic logo assembly. The app implements a weighted point system for random link discovery — the more points assigned to a link, the higher its chance of being surfaced.

Key Features

  • Cinematic GSAP-powered splash screen with narrative animation sequence
  • Firebase Authentication & Realtime Database integration
  • Custom client-side SPA router (no framework)
  • Weighted point system for intelligent random link discovery
  • Secure PIN lock with DOM-hiding protection (visibility:hidden + inert)
  • Multi-layered website preview: iframe → OG image → screenshot API → favicon
  • Advanced caching with invalidation strategies
  • Duplicate link prevention & safe delete ordering
  • Responsive sidebar with logo-as-toggle behavior
  • SVG logo with blue-to-cyan gradient variants

Tech Stack

Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 | Database: Firebase Realtime Database | Auth: Firebase Auth | Animation: GSAP (GreenSock) | Storage: LocalStorage, IndexedDB | APIs: Screenshot APIs, OG scraping

Version History

Started early 2024. Current version: v1.4.5 (April 2026). Ongoing active development with multiple architectural iterations including cache invalidation fixes, dangerous delete-order corrections, and duplicate function consolidation.

seo_description: Linkivo is a sophisticated Progressive Web App for intelligent link management. Features Firebase backend, GSAP animations, PIN auth, and a weighted discovery algorithm.

content:

title: Project Exporter Pro — Universal Export Engine
short_description: A self-contained JavaScript export engine with Shadow DOM isolation supporting PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, and CMYK exports.
content:
About This Project

Project Exporter Pro is an open-source, self-contained JavaScript export engine I built for the developer community. It handles multiple output formats — PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, and CMYK — and is architected as a Shadow DOM Web Component, meaning it can be dropped into any existing project without style conflicts.

Why Shadow DOM?

Most export libraries either pollute the global stylesheet or require careful CSS isolation. By encapsulating the entire engine inside a Shadow DOM, Exporter Pro guarantees zero conflicts with the host application regardless of its CSS framework or custom styles.

Key Features

  • Multi-format export: PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, CMYK
  • Shadow DOM encapsulation — zero style conflicts
  • Fully self-contained, no external runtime dependencies
  • Built-in live README documentation modal
  • Clean programmatic API for integration
  • Quality control options per format
  • Batch export capabilities
  • Browser-native file download

Tech Stack

Language: Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 | Architecture: Shadow DOM, Web Components | Rendering: Canvas API | Export: Native browser APIs | Published: GitHub (open source)
seo_title: Project Exporter Pro — Universal JS Export Engine | Muhtasim Rahman
seo_description: Open-source JavaScript export engine with Shadow DOM isolation. Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, CMYK. Drop-in for any web project with zero style conflicts.
